directory.purpose: Website discovery only, not colour evidence. Exact ONS joins; three explicit historical metropolitan identifier changes documented in import_colours.py.

methodology: Verified values are exact official SVG fill/stroke literals, opaque raster pixels, or (Redbridge only, following the user-directed dark-red correction) the official primary brand-palette CSS token with a verified paint selector. No hashes, arbitrary palettes, inferred darkening or unrelated UI accents generate colours.
Official .gov.uk homepages and committee/consultation portals validate assets. Three council-published CDN uploads retain linking official HTML excerpts, excerpt hashes and full-source-page hashes.
Selections are representative, not necessarily unique or dominant. Multicolour, raster-compressed, monochrome and older variants are identified in notes.
Logo-icon fields are part of the officially supplied emblem composition. Reversed-white Havering is explicit, not sold as a distinctive corporate hue.
Unknown authorities have null colours and sources. London was prioritised, followed by a bounded national county/metropolitan/unitary batch; not every council has been researched.

Offline rebuild: python scripts\import_colours.py --build. Raster investigation uses optional Pillow. Evidence must match SHA-256; source retention does not imply endorsement or permission to republish logos.
